_about: Eval set for /analyze. Each case: a real job (description summarised in our own words) + the expected answer. score_range = scores I'd accept; must_match / must_miss = skills that must appear in that list; never_match = skills the resume does NOT show, so claiming them is a hallucination. Resume: evals/resume-v6.txt.

cases.job_description:
AI intern delivering customer-facing AI solutions for global clients (e.g. FIFA, Formula 1) in Computer Vision, Multimodal AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation.

Responsibilities:
- Turn customer requirements into AI solutions; build and test CV and multimodal RAG applications
- Build data pipelines, model evaluation workflows and proof-of-concept demos
- Fine-tune and optimise models; support integration, testing and deployment
- Research new AI technologies; document findings and present progress

Requirements:
- Pursuing a Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in CS, AI, Data Science, SE, EE or related
- Strong interest in Generative AI, Computer Vision and Multimodal AI
- Solid Python; ML and deep learning fundamentals
- Basic understanding of LLMs, RAG, vector databases and prompt engineering
- One or more of: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex
- Problem solving, fast learner, good communication

Full-stack intern at a startup building web apps, dashboards, enterprise systems and AI-powered tools.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and improve web applications and responsive frontends
- Backend development, API integration and database work
- Help build AI-powered applications, automation tools and integrations
- Debug, test and deploy; follow version control and code quality practices

Requirements:
- Diploma/Degree in CS, SE, IT or related (strong self-taught portfolios welcome)
- JavaScript or TypeScript
- React, Next.js, Vite or similar
- Basics of backend, REST APIs and databases
- Nice to have: Node.js, SQL, Git
- Full-time, on-site in Kuala Lumpur

Hybrid software engineering and business analysis intern at a consultancy, using AI tools responsibly on real client projects.

Responsibilities:
- Join client sessions to understand business needs; draft process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specs (with AI assistance, then review)
- Build and enhance web apps and APIs (.NET, React, SQL, Microsoft Azure)
- Prototype with AI coding assistants, and review, test and own the generated code
- Troubleshoot issues, write and run test cases, support client UAT, write documentation
- Secure coding: never put confidential data, credentials or API keys into AI tools or repositories

Requirements:
- Pursuing a Bachelor's in CS, SE, IT, Business Information Systems or related
- Fundamentals in C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java, plus basic SQL
- Clear written and spoken communication; curiosity about how businesses work
- Nice to have: AI coding tools (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT), .NET, React, Azure, Power Platform/Dynamics 365, basic Git, a portfolio or GitHub to walk through

Software developer intern building enterprise digital financial applications across the full SDLC.

Responsibilities:
- Object-oriented design and development of enterprise applications to specification
- SIT and UAT support; troubleshoot and fix issues
- Help prepare functional specifications and UAT scripts with the business team
- Learn the clients' business domain and process flows
- Exposure to Spring, Angular, React, Kubernetes, Gradle, Docker, Bootstrap, Ionic and microservices

Requirements:
- Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or related, minimum CGPA 3.20
- Java focus (per job title)
- On-site in Damansara Uptown; open to travel

Backend engineering intern for a digital bank.

Responsibilities:
- Build distributed systems that communicate via REST and messaging
- Java focus
- Write clean, testable code and follow best coding practices
- Understand the reasoning behind technical decisions; deliver incremental milestones with the team

Requirements:
- Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or related
- Curiosity and continuous learning
- Strong ownership of assigned work

Software developer intern with a front-end emphasis, at HQ in Puchong (Mon–Fri, on-site).

Requirements:
- Front-end development with Angular, React, Vue or Next.js
- HTML, CSS and JavaScript
- API integration (RESTful APIs)
- Git or Bitbucket
- Figma or Sketch
- SQL or NoSQL, .NET Core
- Pursuing a Diploma or Degree in CS, SE or related
- Good communication, proactive, eager to learn

Web development intern on a structured training programme, then real project work; possible junior developer offer after graduation. Hybrid (one week a month in the office).

Responsibilities:
- Complete web development training focused on CakePHP, system architecture and coding standards
- Help developers with coding, features, unit testing and maintenance
- Use AI tools to learn faster, debug logically and turn requirements into code
- Clear, proactive communication with mentors and the team

Requirements:
- HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP
- Strong OOP and MVC fundamentals
- Willing to learn CakePHP
- Daily hands-on use of AI development tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude)

Digital and automation intern with the Sustainability, Digital and Finance teams, improving data accuracy between financial transactions and the CloudApps system.

Responsibilities:
- Map existing processes and find gaps between finance records and CloudApps
- Explore, test and evaluate digital solutions for data discrepancies
- Write code and build automated workflows, e.g. automating electricity (TNB) bill entries into CloudApps

Requirements:
- Pursuing a Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or related
- Basic programming, interest in automation
- Comfortable processing and analysing large volumes of data
- Analytical, detail-oriented, good communication and teamwork

Intern at a software and digital solutions company (custom software, cloud, AI-driven solutions, data analytics, IoT).

Responsibilities:
- Help design, develop, test and deploy web or mobile applications
- Implement features and improve existing systems with senior developers
- Clean, maintainable code; code reviews, debugging and troubleshooting
- Integrate APIs and third-party services; write documentation
- Work with product and design teams; prepare testing and performance reports

Requirements:
- Pursuing or completed a degree/diploma in CS, Software Engineering or related
- Basic JavaScript, Python, PHP or Java
- HTML, CSS and at least one framework (React, Laravel, Node.js, Flutter)
- Databases (MySQL, MongoDB or PostgreSQL) an advantage
- Problem solving, independent and team work, communication and time management

Software engineering intern at a coworking company: Google Apps Script automation, Node.js backend development and cloud projects (GCP, AWS).

Responsibilities:
- Help develop, test and maintain software; collaborate with senior developers on requirements
- Take part in code reviews; write clean, documented code
- Troubleshoot and debug existing codebases for departments and customers
- Improve development processes and tools
- Support customers and other departments; help with community and member-engagement events

Requirements:
- Pursuing a Diploma or Degree in CS, Software Engineering or related
- JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, PHP and Node.js
- Web development (front-end or back-end)
- Works with minimal supervision; strong communication and collaboration

Embedded systems intern writing firmware for industrial sensors.

Requirements:
- Rust and embedded C
- Real-time operating systems (RTOS)
- Reading electronic schematics; oscilloscope experience
